invite.title: Join {workspace}
invite.sub: {inviter} invited you as {role}. You’ll share the workspace’s projects and credits.
invite.mismatch: This invite is for {email}. You’re logged in as {current}.
invite.missing.title: Invite not found
invite.missing.sub: Check the link in the email, or ask for a new invite.
invite.accepted.title: This invite was already used
invite.accepted.sub: If that was you, the workspace is in your account menu.
invite.revoked.title: This invite was withdrawn
invite.expired.title: This invite has expired
invite.expired.sub: Invites last 7 days. Ask {inviter} for a new one.
invite.error.noSeat: The workspace has no free seat right now. Ask {inviter} to add one.
invite.error.otherEmail: This invite is for a different email address.
invite.error.used: This invite can no longer be used.
invite.error.load: Couldn’t load this invite. Check your connection and reload.
